text:
Which statement about electromagnetic induction is correct?
A
A conductor moving parallel to magnetic field lines induces an electromotive force (e.m.f.) in
the conductor.
B
The direction of the induced electromotive force (e.m.f.) opposes the change which produces
it.
C
The induced current is in a direction parallel to the direction of motion producing it.
D
The induced electromotive force (e.m.f.) decreases when the speed of the conductor moving
across the field lines increases.
